Class B (NYSE:UPS) is expanding its global network with new hubs in the Philippines, Ontario and Hong Kong while modestly stronger parcel volumes, rational pricing and cost cuts are starting to stabilize margins, prompting an analyst to keep a Buy rating with a $132 target.

: UPS to open new Philippines hub at Clark Airport later this year, a Canadian Ontario facility next year, and an air hub at Hong Kong International Airport planned for 2028; part of network expansion.

: UPS CFO said volumes and parcel demand are modestly stronger than expected; rational pricing plus cost cuts and efficiency gains are starting to stabilize margins. Analyst kept Buy with $132 target.
